brand.name: CfCbazar
brand.description: CfCbazar is a DIY digital provider brand producing guides, tools, entertainment, and useful digital products.

website.role: Central DIY hub for tools, guides, entertainment and WorkToken.

playlists.name: CfC Free TV
playlists.description: Curated free shows, public-domain programs, documentaries, indie content, and open-access entertainment.

youtube.role: Traffic engine and trust builder for CfCbazar DIY ecosystem.

etsy.role: DIY digital goods store for printables and eGuides.
strategy: Convert DIY pages into printable PDFs.
List each guide as a digital download.
Link back to CfCbazar website and YouTube.
Use CfCbazar branding on covers and descriptions.

ebay.role: DIY bundles store for multi-pack digital products.
strategy: Provide bundles of multiple DIY guides.
Offer themed packs (ESP8266, CAN tools, entertainment).
Use CfCbazar branding and cross-links to website.

shopify.role: Official CfCbazar store and central product catalog.
strategy: List all digital products and bundles.
Add blog posts for DIY topics.
Build email list for CfCbazar updates.
Use Shopify as main store; others feed traffic into it.

amazon_kdp.role: Authority builder via DIY ebooks and guides.
amazon_kdp.author: CfCbazar Group
strategy: Publish DIY electronics and digital tools guides.
Include links to CfCbazar website, YouTube, and Shopify in each book.
Use KDP to build long-term credibility and passive traffic.

guides: BJT Motor Control & Transistor Circuit Guide
LM2576 & LM317 Adjustable Power Supply Guides

phases.name: Brand Foundation
actions: Define CfCbazar as a DIY digital provider brand.
Add CfCbazar logo and footer to all products and pages.
Add CfCbazar intro/outro to YouTube videos.
Add cross-links between website, YouTube, and all stores.

phases.name: Product Expansion
actions: Convert all DIY pages into printable PDFs for Etsy.
Provide bundles for eBay (multi-guide packs).
Publish key guides as ebooks on Amazon KDP.
List all products and bundles on Shopify.

phases.name: Traffic Loop
actions: Add YouTube links to all store listings.
Add store and website links to all YouTube descriptions.
Add CfC Free TV and other playlists to relevant pages.
Use the website as the central hub linking to all platforms.

phases.name: Marketing
actions: Share DIY guides and tools on Reddit and niche forums.
Post product previews and links in Facebook and Discord communities.
Use Pinterest for visual pins of guides and printables.
Experiment with short-form video (Shorts/Reels/TikTok) for CfCbazar highlights.
Build and grow an email list via Shopify.

phases.name: Optimization
actions: Use PHP visit logger to track page views and popular content.
Improve titles, thumbnails, and descriptions based on performance.
Refine SEO on CfCbazar pages and product listings.
Add new DIY tools, guides, and videos regularly.
Test bundles, pricing, and cross-promotions across platforms.
